columns.text: "Creation eagerly awaits the revealing of the sons of God" Rom 8:19-21

The same phrase, the sons of God, also appears much earlier when they watched God lay earth’s foundations.  Job 38:3-7 Who were those sons of God? Why is creation waiting for you? What critical role were you created to play? This is the story of Yahweh’s two families, the heavenly sons of God and the earthly sons of God.  From Eden to when He dwells with them in Paradise.

pages.title: God dwells with His Families
pages.description:
The story of what is happening behind the scenes of Creation - from Genesis to Revelation.

Understand passages there were a little strange instead of passing over them.  You will see and understand the bible like you never did before.

As you read this story, the Word of God will open up next to it with a single click or tap.

columns.text: Before everything existed, Yahweh wanted to dwell with a human family. 1 So He created the heavens and the earth and placed (Adam) in the garden of Eden. Love would be the basis for relationships in His presence. 2 God, whose name is Yahweh, planned to cover the whole earth with human beings. 3  That was, and still is, God's plan. 4
1 Eph 1:3–5 2 Mrk 12:29-30 3 Gen 1:28 4 Isa 55:11

However, something is not mentioned in that account.  Before Yahweh created the earth, sons of God were rejoicing; they could not be human beings as they had not been created yet; they were heavenly beings. 1 Heavenly beings are sent by God to minister to human beings on earth. 2   God's plan is to dwell with both His human and heavenly families on earth, forever. 3 Eden is where Yahweh, His heavenly family (sons of God) were able to dwell with His human family (Adam, son of God). 4
1 Job 38:4-7 2 Heb 1:14 3 Zec 2:10-11 4 Luk 3:38

headings.name: Mankind was created in God's Image

columns.text: Yahweh planted the garden of Eden in the earth and chose to start with one couple -- Adam and Eve. He created them in His image. 1  God gave them dominion over all the earth to keep and tend it.  God walked with them in Eden, with the tree of life, and everything was very good. 2
1 Gen 1:27 2 Gen 1:28-31
Adam unfortunately sinned and had to leave Eden.  This website is the story of how Yahweh will establish a Paradise for the sons of God (both human and heavenly).
